# **Gaps — no SOP yet**

- **Member Onboarding** – no documented path from signup → first class → retention checkpoint (fitness studios bleed 40%+ in first 30 days; this is your biggest leak)
- **Cancellation & Churn** – no win-back protocol, exit interview process, or pause-before-cancel funnel
- **Member Check-ins** – no scheduled touchpoint cadence (day 7, 30, 90) or escalation when engagement drops
- **Coaching Development Roadmap** – no clear progression from hire → competent → lead coach (affects class quality consistency and retention)
- **Class Quality Audit Checklist** – no systematic way to measure coaching delivery, energy, safety, progression cues (you're flying blind on what members actually experience)
- **Member data privacy & GDPR** – critical gap for UK business; no documented handling of personal data, consent, deletion requests, or breach protocol
- **Referral Programme** – no documented mechanics, incentive structure, or fulfilment process (low-hanging revenue)
- **Order Supplies & Sundries** – no reorder triggers, vendor management, or inventory thresholds (bottleneck for day-to-day operations)
- **Troubleshooting Guide** – no rapid-response playbook for common issues (equipment failure, injury during class, member complaints, staffing gaps)
- **Weekly Key Coach Tasks** – no clarity on non-class duties (form checks, retention calls, social content, goal reviews)
- **30 Day Goals & Member Outcomes** – no structured goal-setting or outcome tracking (limits ability to demonstrate value, repeat business, referrals)

# Service Menu Build for The Forge

**START HERE (This Week):**
- **Audit what you're ACTUALLY selling right now** — grab your last 20 invoices/receipts, your current website, any Instagram posts mentioning offers. You're probably selling more than you realize (classes, PT, nutrition plans, challenges, merch?). Write it all down messy first.

**BUILD THE COACH VERSION (What They Need to Sell):**
- **One-page visual breakdown** — each service tier with: price point, time commitment, what THEY promise members (not what you promise), common objections they'll hear, and your margin/profit on it. Coaches won't upsell what confuses them.
- **Anchor one "hero" service** — usually the 6-week transformation package or unlimited membership. Make that the reference point everything else hangs off. Everything else is a gateway or upgrade to it.

**BUILD THE MEMBER VERSION (What Gets Buyers):**
- **Price it in "cost per visit" language, not monthly fees** — members think in sessions/access, not calendar months. *"£8.50 per class" hits different than "£69/month unlimited."* Test both if pricing is flexible.
- **Stack inclusions backwards from objections** — what stops someone buying? ("I don't know if I can commit," "I'm intimidated," "I don't have time") Build those answers INTO your service descriptions upfront.

**Lock it down by Friday** — print it, share with 3 coaches, ask *"would you confidently sell this?"* Iterate once. You're done.
